scope_gaps.note: The title speaks of persistent low mood (utrzymujące się obniżenie nastroju); the gov.pl snapshots speak of psychological or emotional crisis and say nothing on duration. The statement about exercise has no available source.
The trigger 'nastrój utrudnia codzienne życie' is not a criterion in the snapshots; they speak of crisis and of need for a specialist.

The snapshots give 112, 999 and an emergency room or psychiatric-ward hospital as the options for a sudden threat to life or health; the sentence names only 112 and adds a contrast with the support line that the source does not state.
The snapshots do not mention severe symptoms or suicidal risk and do not say a clinical assessment is required; they cover a sudden threat to life or health.
The snapshots list the support line and the emergency numbers for different situations but do not state that one does not replace the other.
